            FROM jsonb_array_elements(ws.snapshot->'nodes') elem

            LIMIT 1
          ) as "trigger" from "workflow" as "w" inner join "workflow_snapshot" as "ws" on "w"."active_snapshot_id" = "ws"."id" where "w"."is_active" = true and "w"."subscribe_resource_id" = 'tbltglLHIVChdLbxc3Y' and "w"."subscribe_trigger_type" in ('recordCreated', 'recordUpdated', 'recordCreatedOrUpdated', 'recordMatchesConditions', 'formSubmitted', 'buttonClick') and "w"."deleted_time" is null
